description: Get the text of a section of the Mississippi Code of 1972 (Annotated) — Mississippi state law — by citation. "97-3-19" is homicide/murder; "89-8-19" is a landlord's duty to return a security deposit. Accepts natural forms: "97-3-19", "Miss. Code Ann. § 97-3-19", "Section 97-3-19", "§ 97-3-19". Returns the catchline, the operative statutory text, the legislative "HISTORY:" line, and amendment/cross-reference notes when present — case-law annotations are deliberately excluded (can run to hundreds of entries per section). IMPORTANT: this source is a static public-domain copy current only through Release 78 (2020-07-08) — it will NOT reflect any amendment enacted 2021 or later; check `current_through` on every response. Also returns later_acts: a dated, linked overlay of every act this pack found in Mississippi's own signed-bill text touching this exact citation since the 2020-07-08 snapshot (chapter number, session, bill link) — NOT merged into the text, explicitly labelled so, with sessions_checked naming every session the overlay covers even when later_acts is empty. Use for "what does MS 97-3-19 say" or to check a Mississippi statute AND whether it has been amended since 2020-07-08. Keyless.

citation.description: Section citation, e.g. "97-3-19" (homicide) or "89-8-19" (security deposits). Title-chapter-section, dot/hyphen separated.
